name: XLA_TRANSACTION_INT_CONTROLS
description: This table stores information of each processing group imported to Accounting Hub including its processing status and associated application.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: PROCESSING_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: Name of the processing group for this request.

columns.name: COMBINED_IMPORT_AND_LOAD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the initial request for this processing group is only to load data to the interface table, or also import the transactions to Accounting Hub.

columns.name: HEADER_INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the interface table that contains the transaction header data for this processing group.

columns.name: LINE_INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the interface table that contains the transaction line data for this processing group.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the import of transaction data from the file, into the interface table, and from there into the transaction table, for this processing group.

columns.name: IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request ID of the request that is importing this processing group from the interface table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REVERSAL_INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of interface table that contains the transaction reversal data for this processing group.
